key_insight: Explainable deep reinforcement learning can optimize residential building energy management while making battery-control decisions understandable to operators.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps lower electricity costs and improve operational stability for buildings with PV, batteries, dynamic tariffs, and weather-dependent demand.
method: Trained on-policy and off-policy DRL agents for building energy control
Used an expanded state space with demand, PV output, battery status, prices, weather, calendar, and forecasts
Applied post-hoc interpretation methods to explain learned policies
evidence_signal: The models were evaluated on both synthetic data and real-world Living Lab Energy Campus (LLEC) data, with A2C and PPO showing the best cumulative rewards and policy stability.
watch_item: Explainability is post-hoc, so the insights may not fully capture all internal decision logic and should be validated before deployment.
paper_title: Explainable Data-driven Deep Reinforcement Learning Methods for Optimal Energy Management in Buildings
